description: This file defines an interface 'IndexInitializationConfig' that provides configuration settings related to index initialization in a MongoDB context. It includes a method to check if index initialization is enabled and an enumeration of configuration values with default settings.

classes.name: IndexInitializationConfig
classes.description: An interface providing configuration methods for index initialization, including a method to check if such initialization is enabled, and an internal enum for known configuration values.

methods.name: isIndexInitializationConfigEnabled
methods.description: Returns true if index initialization configuration is enabled; false otherwise.
